title.zh: OpenAI 洽谈至少300亿美元融资，投前估值约1.4万亿美元
title.en: OpenAI in talks for at least $30B funding at ~$1.4T pre-money valuation

current_state.zh: OpenAI 正与总部位于阿布扎比的 MGX 及其他阿联酋投资基金洽谈，由后者领投至少 300 亿美元的融资轮，贝莱德正讨论参与，投前估值固定约为 1.4 万亿美元，同时该公司推迟了 IPO。
current_state.en: OpenAI is in talks with Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other UAE investment funds to anchor a financing round of at least $30 billion, with BlackRock discussing participation and a fixed ~$1.4 trillion pre-money valuation, as the company defers its IPO.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI计划以1.4万亿美元估值融资300亿美元
updates.title_en: OpenAI计划以1.4万亿美元估值融资300亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 BlockBeats 援引彭博社 9 月 30 日的报道，OpenAI 计划以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元。该报道描述的是一项融资计划，并未表明交易已经完成。

若按此规模完成，这将是史上规模最大的私募融资之一，所募资金将直接投入 OpenAI 的算力建设，并影响其与其他前沿 AI 实验室的竞争格局。

该数字来源于彭博社，时间标注为 9 月 30 日；报道所描述的核心要素是融资金额、估值，以及该融资目前仍属计划、而非已完成交易这一事实。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI is reportedly planning to raise $30 billion in funding at a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI is reportedly planning to raise $30 billion in funding at a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI is reportedly planning to raise $30 billion in funding at a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg.
updates.market_impact_zh: OpenAI 的股权并不在加密市场直接交易，因此其影响主要通过情绪与资金流向传导至 AI 叙事相关资产，例如去中心化算力与 AI Agent 类代币；同时，如此规模的私募融资也会影响整体私募市场的流动性环境，进而关系到加密与 AI 创业项目可获得的冒险资本规模。
updates.market_impact_en: OpenAI equity is not directly tradable in crypto markets, so any transmission runs through sentiment and capital flows around AI-narrative assets — decentralized compute and AI-agent tokens — as well as broader private-market liquidity conditions that shape how much risk capital is available to crypto and AI ventures alike.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI推迟IPO后，以高达1.4万亿美元估值寻求300亿美元融资
updates.title_en: OpenAI seeks $30 billion in funding at whopping $1.4 trillion valuation after delaying IPO
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI在将IPO推迟至2026年之后，正以约1.4万亿美元估值寻求至少300亿美元新融资，其年化收入已超过400亿美元；而Anthropic预计将于11月IPO，潜在估值超过2万亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI is seeking at least $30 billion in new funding at roughly a $1.4 trillion valuation after postponing its IPO beyond 2026, with annualized revenue surpassing $40 billion, while Anthropic is expected to IPO in November at a potential valuation above $2 trillion.
